arguments.description: Read the existing release 1.0 agreement record

arguments.command: bd remember 'Meridian Credits release "2.0" credit agreement (Finance-approved and permanently adopted as the CURRENT agreement, per issue trial-a6r; supersedes release 1.0 as current). Applies to every supplied charge set regardless of service dates. An omitted release now selects "2.0"; explicit "2.0" behaves identically; explicit "1.0" still uses the original agreement (see key meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-agreement). Rules: (1) uncapped line credit = 15% of charge_cents, floored per line to integer cents; (2) credit cap 3000 cents shared by all lines with the same (account_id, subscription_id) pair; distinct pairs have independent caps (same subscription_id under different accounts = different groups); (3) within a cap group, priority = largest charge_cents first, ties by increasing line_id (Unicode code-point order); service_on never affects priority; each line gets its uncapped credit up to the remaining cap, later lines get the remainder or zero; (4) total credit = sum of line credits; line amount_due = charge - credit; total due = total charges - total credit. Request/response shapes unchanged from 1.0: quote {"command":"quote","line":LINE[,"release":R]} -> exactly {release, line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents}; total {"command":"total","lines":[LINE,...][,"release":R]} -> exactly {release, credit_cents, amount_due_cents}; the response release identifies the agreement actually used; unsupported release -> {"error":"unsupported_release"}. Example: quote L-1 charge 19999 with omitted release -> {"release":"2.0","credit_cents":2999,"amount_due_cents":17000,"line_id":"L-1"}. Implementation: main.py RELEASES table holds per-release rate_percent, cap_cents, cap_group key, and priority sort key; CURRENT_RELEASE = "2.0"; assign_credits(lines, rules) is the shared cap/priority engine. Public suite: python3 test_public.py --cases public_tests/release_2_quote_total.json (release 1 suites remain applicable and must keep passing).' --key 'meridian-credits/release-2.0-credit-agreement' && bd remember 'Meridian Credits release "1.0" credit agreement (Finance-approved, per issue trial-4tt). HISTORICAL: as of issue trial-a6r, release 1.0 is no longer the current agreement; an omitted release now selects "2.0" (see key meridian-credits/release-2.0-credit-agreement). Release 1.0 remains supported and is used only when a request sends explicit "release":"1.0". Rules: (1) uncapped line credit = 10% of charge_cents, floored per line to integer cents; (2) credit cap 2400 cents shared by all lines with the same account_id across its subscriptions, independent per account; (3) within a cap group, priority = earliest service_on first, ties by increasing line_id (Unicode code-point order); each line gets its uncapped credit up to the remaining cap, later lines get the remainder or zero; (4) total credit = sum of line credits; line amount_due = charge - credit; total due = total charges - total credit. Data model: line has exactly line_id, account_id, subscription_id, service_on (YYYY-MM-DD, 2020-01-01..2099-12-31), charge_cents (nonneg int); subscription key is (account_id, subscription_id); caps apply within one request. Quote command: {"command":"quote","line":LINE,"release":"1.0"} -> exactly {release, line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents}; single line is treated as the whole statement. Total command (issue trial-fjv): {"command":"total","lines":[LINE,...],"release":"1.0"} -> exactly {release, credit_cents, amount_due_cents}; caps apply across the whole supplied set, not per line; empty lines -> credit 0, due 0. Implementation: main.py RELEASES["1.0"] entry (rate_percent 10, cap_cents 2400, cap_group account_id, priority (service_on, line_id)); assign_credits(lines, rules) runs the cap/priority engine; quote() and total() both call it. Public suites: python3 test_public.py --cases public_tests/release_1_quote.json and public_tests/release_1_total.json.' --key 'meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-agreement' && echo "=== recall 2.0" && bd recall 'meridian-credits/release-2.0-credit-agreement' && echo && echo "=== recall 1.0" && bd recall 'meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-agreement'
